rules_discovered.title: Visual Grounding Mandatory
rules_discovered.lesson: Never declare task complete based on assumption. Always capture screen and verify icons and windows with eyes.

rules_discovered.title: Zero Cartoon Games Policy
rules_discovered.lesson: Janob Muzaffar dislikes cartoon/baby 2D games (Zuma, Panda, PvZ). Only modern, serious 3D games must be on Desktop.

rules_discovered.title: PowerShell Non-Interactive Immunity
rules_discovered.lesson: Never run multi-line or unquoted powershell commands in cmd. They wait on interactive stdin and hang for hours. Always use Python scripts or -NonInteractive flags.
